snippet.title: KUR - Endless Descent
snippet.description:
KUR: Endless Descent is an idle RPG set in the Mesopotamian underworld. Lead a party of heroes down through floors and seven Domains, past the Gates and the guardians that hold them, and keep descending even while you're away.

• 8 heroes, each with their own skills and skill tree
• Seven Domains of the underworld, each with its own creatures and guardians
• A camp to forge, fuse and refine your gear between descents
• Built to run quietly in a small window on your desktop

Wishlist KUR on Steam and follow the descent:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5332430
